The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. It holds scrambled egg whites, or possibly a soft cheese, plus about 5 pieces of cantaloupe or papaya.

**Egg whites:** The pale food covers roughly a third of the plate. I estimate about 120 g. At roughly 50 kcal per 100 g, that is about 60 kcal. If it is whole-egg scramble the figure would be closer to 150 kcal per 100 g, but the color looks white, so I'm assuming egg whites.

**Orange fruit:** There are 5 chunks of about 20 g each, so about 100 g. At roughly 40 kcal per 100 g, that is about 40 kcal.

**Total:** About 220 g of food and about 100 kcal. Since the pale food could be a little more calorie-dense than egg whites, I'm rounding up to about 130 kcal.
